answer: Branching skill-tree progression stops Sybil attacks in four steps. First, a new agent starts at one root skill and unlocks higher branches after verified jobs below. Second, each unlock needs three peer signatures on work, so fakes cannot climb by copying. Third, branches expire after sixty idle days, forcing fakes to keep working. Fourth, fraud prunes the branch and forfeits a $25 bond. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 climbers plus $55,000 in bonds and fees, lost if caught. Trust climbs a spiral staircase, not a mirror of copies, solid as ivory, like a cook earning each kitchen station.
